notes: §1985:VIII.3.2.2 prints the relative file's FD with five optional clauses: BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD (three forms), LABEL RECORD(S) with STANDARD or OMITTED, VALUE OF with implementor-name-1 IS before every data-name-2 or literal-1, and DATA RECORD(S). The BLOCK CONTAINS and RECORD arms conform at 85: blockContainsClause and recordClause parse every form, Rows admits the three obsolete clauses to every format and removes them only from 2002, FileDescriptionClauseAdmitted refuses LINAGE, CODE-SET and REPORT on a relative file (COBOL2604), BYTES is COBOL0900, a repeated clause COBOL2423 and any other word COBOL1970 through VisitUnrecognizedClause. The LABEL and VALUE OF arms do not hold their format: labelRecordsClause ends in (STANDARD | OMITTED | cobolWord+) and valueOfClause is VALUE OF (cobolWord | literal | IS)+, no binder reads either, so LABEL RECORDS ARE IGNORED, LABEL RECORDS ARE a data-name and VALUE OF with no implementor-name compile clean on a relative FD (the mechanism kb/Work PB5070 holds for the sequential and report FDs; this rule is not in its list). The printed page VIII-14 underlines RECORDS and not CHARACTERS in BLOCK CONTAINS, as §1985:VII.3.3.2 transcribes it, so BLOCK CONTAINS 10 with no unit is the format and is rightly accepted; the transcription of §1985:VIII.3.2.2 underlines CHARACTERS and is wrong there. The witness writes and reads a relative file whose FD carries BLOCK, RECORD, LABEL and DATA RECORD.

next.reason: 1985 relative FD allows BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD, LABEL RECORD(S) STANDARD/OMITTED, VALUE OF implementor-name-1 and DATA RECORD(S). §2023:13.4.5.2 Format 2 'relative-or-indexed' (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR7) keeps BLOCK CONTAINS (§2023:13.18.10.2) and the record-clause (§2023:13.18.43.2, BYTES a synonym per §2023:13.18.43.3 SR2) but has no LABEL, VALUE OF or DATA RECORDS clause anywhere in the standard, so a 1985 relative FD using them is refused. EXTERNAL/GLOBAL are not new (1985 X.4.2.2). CHANGED (stricter).
